items.label: General Government Gross Debt
items.note: Annual IMF debt ratio; the GS guide warns that UK PSND and general-government debt differ by sector boundary and liquid-asset treatment.

items.label: Gross External Debt
items.note: Component-based external-debt liability estimate from ECB balance-of-payments positions, scaled by Eurostat rolling four-quarter nominal GDP; direct-investment intercompany debt may need national-release cross-checks. Official ECB BPS component stack; direct-investment intercompany debt is not included unless reported through the selected debt-instrument components, so compare with national external-debt releases. Source validation: Latest observation is 1016 days old for quarterly data.

items.label: Central Bank Balance Sheet, % GDP
items.source: National Bank of Romania Monthly Bulletin / Romania Ministry of Finance GDP snapshot
items.note: Central-bank total assets scaled by nominal GDP from BIS/World Bank where available, or official national-bank and GDP snapshots where automated coverage is missing; monthly numerator is paired with annual GDP, so use as a balance-sheet scale proxy rather than exact national-account ratio. Maintained in config/manual_indicators.yaml; revise manually when source values change. Source validation: Latest observation is 620 days old for monthly data. Short history returned by adapter. Manual snapshot maintained because BIS CBTA does not currently return Romania coverage in this pipeline and BNR's direct statistical-data endpoints reject automated access in this environment. Update when the latest BNR monthly bulletin and current-price GDP snapshot are refreshed.
